input.question: Which award was Soulcalibur VI nominated for?

documents.text:
**Soulcalibur VI Earns Prestigious Nomination for The Game Awards - Best Fighting**

In a testament to its exceptional gameplay and dedication to the fighting game genre, Soulcalibur VI has been nominated for The Game Awards - Best Fighting, one of the most coveted honors in the gaming industry. Released in 2018, Soulcalibur VI has been praised by critics and fans alike for its stunning visuals, revamped combat mechanics, and rich storyline. The game's nomination for The Game Awards - Best Fighting is a well-deserved recognition of the hard work and dedication of the development team at Bandai Namco. "We are thrilled to see Soulcalibur VI nominated for The Game Awards - Best Fighting," said Motohiro Okubo, Producer of Soulcalibur VI. "This nomination is a testament to the passion and dedication of our team, and we are honored to be recognized alongside other exceptional fighting games." The Game Awards, founded in 2014, is one of the most prestigious award ceremonies in the gaming industry, celebrating outstanding achievements in game development, art, and design. The Best Fighting Game category is one of the most competitive, with previous winners including Street Fighter V and Dragon Ball FighterZ. Soulcalibur VI's nomination is substantiated by its impressive critical reception, with an average critic score of 87% on Metacritic, a leading review aggregation platform. The game has also received widespread acclaim from the gaming community, with many praising its improved gameplay mechanics, stunning visuals, and rich storyline. "The nomination of Soulcalibur VI for The Game Awards - Best Fighting is a well-deserved recognition of the game's exceptional quality," said Geoff Keighley, Creator of The Game Awards. "The game's dedication to the fighting game genre and its commitment to innovation and excellence make it a standout title in a highly competitive category." Data from the NPD Group, a leading market research company, reveals that Soulcalibur VI was one of the top-selling fighting games of 2018, with over 1 million copies sold in the United States alone. In conclusion, Soulcalibur VI's nomination for The Game Awards - Best Fighting is a testament to the game's exceptional quality, dedication to the fighting game genre, and widespread critical and commercial success. As the gaming industry continues to evolve, Soulcalibur VI stands as a shining example of innovation and excellence in game development.
